Problem: What is the tens digit in the sum $11^1 + 11^2 + 11^3 + \ldots + 11^9$?

<reflection>
The sum is S = sum_{k=1}^9 11^k. The geometric series formula gives S = 11(11^9 - 1)/10. The listed powers 11^1 through 11^9 are correct, with 11^9 = 2357947691. Substituting gives S = 11 * 2357947690 / 10 = 2593742459.
The tens digit of 2593742459 is not 2; the 2 is in the billions place. The tens digit is the second digit from the right.
Re-evaluate the place values of 2593742459 by reading from right to left, starting with the ones digit.
</reflection>
